text:
Predicates:
EatSalads(x) ::: x eats salads regularly.
Conscious(x) ::: x is very conscious about their health and eating habits.
GrewUpHealthHome(x) ::: x grew up in health-conscious childhood homes.
FulfillNutritionalIntakes(x) ::: x fulfills their nutritional daily intakes.
GoodRelationships(x, y) ::: x has good relationships with y.
VisitGym(x) ::: x visits the gym at least once a day.
Premises:
∀x (EatSalads(x) → Conscious(x)) ::: All people who eat salads regularly are very conscious about their health and eating habits.
∀x (GrewUpHealthHome(x) → EatSalads(x)) ::: All people who grew up in health-conscious childhood homes eat salads regularly.
∀x (FulfillNutritionalIntakes(x) → GrewUpHealthHome(x)) ::: All people who fulfill their nutritional daily intakes grew up in health-conscious childhood homes.
∀x (GoodRelationships(x, parents) → FulfillNutritionalIntakes(x)) ::: If people have good relationships with their parents, then they fulfill their nutritional daily intakes.
∀x (GoodRelationships(x, parents) → ¬EatSalads(x)) ::: If people have good relationships with their parents, then they do not eat salads regularly.
∀x (VisitGym(x) → FulfillNutritionalIntakes(x)) ::: If people visit the gym at least once a day, then they always fulfill their daily nutritional intakes.
(GrewUpHealthHome(taylor) ∧ GoodRelationships(taylor, parents)) ⊕ (¬GrewUpHealthHome(taylor) ∧ ¬GoodRelationships(taylor, parents)) ::: It is either both true that Taylor grew up in a health-conscious childhood home and she has a good relationship with her parents, or it is true that Taylor neither grew up in a health-conscious childhood home nor has a good relationship with her parents.
Conclusion:
¬(GrewUpHealthHome(taylor) ∨ VisitGym(taylor)) ::: Taylor neither grew up in a health-conscious childhood home nor does she visit the gym at least once a day.
